name: The Shadow of Chaos
text: Your army carries a Shadow of Chaos: your deployment zone always, plus No Man's Land or the enemy deployment zone for a phase if you held at least half its markers when the phase began. Your units inside it add 1 to Battle-shock tests and, on a pass, heal D3 wounds (BATTLELINE may return D3 models instead). Enemy units inside it subtract 1 and, on a fail, suffer D3 mortal wounds.

name: A Gory Path
text: When this model's unit makes a Consolidation move, it may move up to 6 inches instead of up to 3 inches. Pile-in moves stay at 3 inches.

name: Collar of Khorne
text: Every model in this unit has a 3+ Feel No Pain save against wounds and mortal wounds caused by Psychic attacks and Psychic abilities.
